one_sentence_story: In 2004 in Nature, Bogdan Draganski and Arne May scanned 24 non-jugglers before training, after 3 months mastering a 60-second 3-ball cascade, and after 3 months of zero practice — proving ordinary visuomotor learning expands gray matter in visual-motion cortex (hMT+/V5) and parietal cortex, and partially shrinks back when left idle ('use it or lose it').
so_what_for_you: Pair desk work with a **visuomotor skill** (juggling, pickleball/tennis, dancing, piano) at ANY age from 20 to 70 — and keep light weekly maintenance reps going so Scan-2 dendritic growth doesn't slide down the Scan-3 slope.
